per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The UI must look and behave like other corporate apps, adhering to corporate UI standards for look-and-feel, accessibility, and component usage.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall comply with the corporate standards for user interface creation for internally and externally used applications.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application must feel snappy, with a maximum of five seconds for routine screen-to-screen transitions.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The maximum wait time for a user navigating from one screen to another within the Disputes application shall be no more than 5 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application must support role-based access control, ensuring that not everyone can initiate disputes and that sensitive data is hidden from unauthorized users.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall ensure that only users with the appropriate access level are allowed to initiate dispute requests.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application must maintain a full, immutable history of all actions performed by representatives, including who did what, when, and any changes made.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application must maintain a detailed history of every action that a user takes on a dispute case. This ensures a complete audit trail if questions arise later on with regard to a particular dispute case.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application must be effectively always available, with scheduled maintenance windows on weekdays from 3:00 AM to 4:00 AM Eastern and on Sundays from 1:00 AM to 5:00 AM Eastern.

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application must support up to 350 concurrent users without degradation in performance.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall support 350 concurrent users without any degradation of performance in the application.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application must follow standard credit card dispute regulations, including specific timelines and notice requirements.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application must conform to the legal requirements as specified by Regulation E and Regulation Z that govern credit card disputes processing.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application must get transaction details straight from the Statement Database and cardmember details from the Cardmember Information Database, with any authoritative data for dispute decisions traceable back to these systems.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall interface with the Statement Database. The Statement Database provides the transaction details to the Disputes System. All transaction details must be obtained from the Statement Database'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application must send adjustment requests to the Cardmember Posting and Billing System, which is the authoritative actor for any financial adjustments.

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application must adhere to corporate UI standards and support different data and controls based on the user's role and whether they are internal or external.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall comply with the corporate standards for user interface creation for internally and externally used applications.'
